annotation: single_author_before_product_outputs; source-ID gold; no independent human agreement claim

documents.text: Production releases require three reviewers.
Emergency hotfixes additionally require incident commander approval.
The release dashboard uses a cyan accent.
The response cache TTL is 37 seconds.
The response cache namespace is cache-v7.
Cache graphs are displayed with rounded counts.
Regular backups are retained for 29 days.
Records under legal hold must never be deleted, regardless of age.
The backup dashboard displays sizes in mebibytes.
The HTTP client retries failed GET requests at most twice.
The HTTP client never retries POST requests automatically.
HTTP client metrics refresh every minute.
Interactive users may submit 120 API requests per minute.
Service accounts have a separate 900-request per minute allowance.
Quota reports are exported as PDF.
The application database engine is PostgreSQL 18.
Production PostgreSQL connections require TLS certificate verification.
The database status page uses a dark background.
Application logs use structured JSON.
Session tokens must be masked before a log entry is written.
The log viewer defaults to a monospace font.
Supported Python versions are 3.12 and 3.13.
Python 3.14 is experimental and must not be used in production.
The Python documentation theme is light.
Release notes are written in Korean.
Public API examples remain in English.
The documentation sidebar is initially expanded.
The service reads its API key from a private file with mode 0600.
API keys must never be passed in command-line arguments.
The credential settings panel has a help button.
Schema changes follow expand-then-contract migrations.
A deprecated database column is removed only after two completed release cycles.
Migration progress is shown as a percentage.
The document embedding vector has 384 dimensions.
Embedding inference must run locally without sending document text to an external service.
The embedding dashboard shows twelve samples per page.
Each CI test shard has a 600-second execution deadline.
After a timeout, the shard receives 15 seconds to shut down gracefully.
CI job names contain their shard index.
Team owners and editors may publish shared project memories.
Viewers may read shared memories but cannot publish them.
Team avatars are displayed as circles.
An explicitly selected configuration file takes precedence over ambient environment settings.
Updating the client must preserve the existing OAuth connection.
Configuration examples use two-space indentation.
Database backup archives are encrypted before leaving the machine.
The decryption identity is stored separately from the backup archive.
Backup archive filenames contain the creation date.
Offline changes remain in a durable local outbox until acknowledged.
A conflicting update must not overwrite a newer server revision automatically.
The sync status icon is displayed in the toolbar.
The maintenance window is Sunday at 03:00 Asia/Seoul.
Maintenance may not interrupt an active database restore.
Maintenance notices use the project logo.
An alert is raised when the oldest queued job is more than five minutes old.
An unknown queue state must not automatically resolve an existing alert.
Alert cards display their creation timestamp.
Each device has a distinct revocable credential.
Revoking one device must not revoke other devices belonging to the same account.
The device list is sorted by its display name.

documents.text: The build cache key includes the compiler version and dependency lock hash.
Debug and release builds must not share cached object files.
Build duration graphs use a weekly view.
Browser session cookies are HttpOnly and use SameSite=Lax.
Session credentials must not appear in URL query parameters.
The login panel has a blue submit button.
Image uploads are limited to eight mebibytes per file.
SVG uploads are rejected even when they are below the size limit.
The image gallery shows square thumbnails.
A list response contains at most 100 items.
Pagination cursors are bound to the original snapshot and cannot be reused for another snapshot.
List headers remain fixed during scrolling.
KRW monetary values are stored as integer won amounts.
Foreign currency conversion uses the exchange rate fixed at invoice creation.
Currency tables align numeric values to the right.
Ordinary notifications are suppressed from 22:00 to 07:00 in the user timezone.
Critical alerts bypass quiet hours only when the user has explicitly opted in.
Notification badges are hidden after they are read.
A marketing unsubscribe takes effect before the next marketing message is queued.
Unsubscribing from marketing does not disable transactional receipts.
Email previews use a white background.
European customer records remain in the EU storage region.
Cross-region replication of those customer records is disabled.
The region selector displays country flags.
The product catalog search index refreshes every 30 seconds.
Deleted products are excluded by the current database state immediately, before index refresh.
The catalog search field has a clear button.
CSV exports use UTF-8 with a byte order mark.
Cells beginning with a spreadsheet formula character are escaped before CSV export.
Export progress is displayed in the footer.
A password reset link expires after 15 minutes.
A reset link becomes invalid immediately after its first successful use.
The password reset screen displays the account logo.
Monthly billing reconciliation closes at 18:00 on the last business day.
Unresolved discrepancies require human review before an invoice is finalized.
The billing overview groups invoices by month.
Webhook delivery retries stop 24 hours after the first attempt.
Webhook HMAC verification covers the exact received request body bytes.
Webhook history shows the most recent delivery first.
Priority support tickets receive a first response within four business hours.
Published public holidays are excluded from support business hours.
The support inbox displays ticket priority with an icon.
Refrigerated shipments must stay between two and eight degrees Celsius.
A temperature excursion causes quarantine until a qualified reviewer releases the shipment.
Shipment labels are printed in landscape orientation.
Pressure sensors are calibrated every 90 days.
A sensor with an expired calibration must not publish production measurements.
Sensor names include their installation zone.
Restarting a notebook kernel clears variables held in memory.
Files already saved to the workspace disk survive a kernel restart.
Notebook sections may be collapsed by the reader.
Reserved inventory may never become negative.
Backorders are accepted only when the product backorder flag is enabled.
Inventory counts are displayed without thousands separators.
Consented audio transcripts are retained for seven days.
Revoking transcription consent removes stored transcripts before another transcription is started.
The audio player displays a waveform preview.
Source code uses tab indentation with a display width of four columns.
YAML files use two spaces per indentation level and must not contain indentation tabs.
The editor minimap is hidden by default.
